title: Insights summary text formats money differently from the KPIs above it
detail: The generated summary on Insights writes negative amounts with an ASCII hyphen ("-$2,970.23", "-$303k") and mixes lowercase and uppercase thousands suffixes in one sentence ("-$303k … $33.4K"). The KPI tiles on the same page use a true minus sign ("−$870,358") and uppercase suffixes. Describing spending as a negative number ("Spending was -$303k") also reads oddly.
evidence: DevTools: summary text node minus char U+002D, class _bodyDefault_qaod7_40; KPI "−$870,358" minus char U+2212, class _titleSecondary_qaod7_20. Same page /insights/overview.

title: Mixed precision for money within one Insights card
detail: The Money in/out cards show the headline in compact form ($1.9M), the section total in whole dollars ($1,909,616 / $870,358), and each row with cents ($1,000,000.00, $415,133.44). Three precisions for the same quantity in one card.
evidence: DevTools text scan on /insights/overview: titleSecondary 24px "$1.9M"; 16px total "$1,909,616"; 15px rows "$1,000,000.00".
